newsitems.title: Games with loot boxes and other "paid random items" re-rated PEGI 16 as new rules come into force, hopefully cutting down on kids gambling somewhat
newsitems.contents:
I'm strongly of the opinion that loot boxes, gacha mechanics and whatever other form of gambling remains present in games is a scourge that ought to be wiped out. Absolutely no game is better for having gacha mechanics in it, only worse. The normalisation of gambling through alternative, softer names, cool cosmetics, and in many cases, cute anime girls is honestly abhorrent. European ratings board PEGI doesn't seem keen on it either, as they've begun enacting recent rule changes bring the default age rating of games that contain these mechanics up to a minimum of PEGI 16.

Read more

newsitems.title: Bungie раскроет планы по возвращению контента в Destiny 2 на следующей неделе
newsitems.contents:
Bungie продолжает работать над возвращением контента, удалённого из Destiny 2 за прошедшие годы. Ранее компания заявила, что «не собирается останавливаться» и намерена сохранить наследие франшизы, начав с восстановления всего, что было убрано из игры.

Как сообщает TheGamePost, Джош Дин ответил игрокам в X, отметив, что команда «планирует выпустить обновление» о процессе разблокировки контента на следующей неделе. В предыдущем посте он признал, что у сообщества могут возникнуть вопросы о разблокировке, потенциальных будущих обновлениях Destiny 2 и о том, что ждёт франшизу в целом.

По словам Дина, процесс будет «очень продуманным», а о первом этапе расскажут ближе к концу октября. Он также уточнил, что предстоящее обновление не будет традиционной дорожной картой — вместо этого информацию представят в виде «индикатора прогресса». Цель — приблизить сообщество к этапам разработки, чётко обозначить возникающие проблемы и предоставить игрокам наглядные доказательства проделанной работы.

Точную дату публикации сообщения Джош Дин не назвал.

find:[/p][list][*][p][b]Progression:[/b] View your progress and the associated rewards across four different progression tracks.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Challenges:[/b] View and track your customization options you’ve unlocked.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Showcase:[/b] Select an unlocked Operator, up to three Calling Cards, and a Wallpaper to add to your Showcase for other players to see.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Progression: Level Unlocks[/h3][p][i]Career / Progression / MP Level Unlocks[/i][/p][p][i]Earn XP to progress through 55 Levels, unlocking Weapons, Equipment, Perks, Killstreaks, and more.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]A Note on DMZ[/b][/p][p]In [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i], DMZ features its own distinct Level Unlock progression track that is separate from the Level 1-55 Multiplayer progression system. As players earn DMZ XP by completing Story Missions, Dynamic Operations, Side Ops, and other activities, they will progress through 70 levels, unlocking DMZ-specific rewards along the way including new Gear and Stations, Station Upgrades, 3D Printer Recipes, Operator Skins, Consumables, Fire Support (Killstreaks), Survival Kits, and more.[/p][p]XP earned while playing DMZ also contributes to your overall 1-55 Player Progression, but XP earned in Multiplayer or [i]Call of Duty®: Warzone[/i]™ does not contribute to your DMZ Level.[/p][p]For more information on DMZ progression, check out our in-depth article, [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1938090/view/714540659097208825"]How to Play DMZ, Part 2: Tour of Duty — Forward Operating Base[/url], as well as the complete DMZ Progression Appendix at the end of this blog.[/p][p][/p][h3]Leveling Up: From Private to Commander[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d1378f146f95ca5fca3eae234090cf7150b17c0b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The first step in your [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] journey begins with a simple goal: climb through the military designations from Private I (Level 1) to Commander (Level 55) by earning XP across Multiplayer, DMZ, and starting in Season 1, Call of Duty: Warzone.[/p][p]Earn XP by playing matches and eliminating enemies, playing the objective, and completing challenges. Each level unlocks foundational rewards that expand your Loadout options with new gear and tactical options so you can further home in on the content that works best for your style of play.[/p][p]As you progress through the military ranks, you’ll unlock the following types of content: [/p][p][/p][p][b]Multiplayer Player Level Unlocks[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Unlocks:[/b] Expect one or more unlocks every time you level up, from Level 1-55[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Loadouts:[/b] Default and Custom[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Weapons:[/b] Primary and Secondary Weapons[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Equipment:[/b] Lethals and Tacticals[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Field Upgrades[/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Perks[/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Killstreaks[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Call of Duty: Warzone Integration Note:[/b] [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Level Unlocks will become accessible in [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] when Season 1 releases shortly after launch.[/p][p][/p][p][b]DMZ Player Level Unlocks[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5c54e9ab7a8f5177a0ee8809cd95aae181159a23.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Unlocks:[/b] Expect one or more unlocks every time you level up, from Level 1-70[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Station Unlocks:[/b] Access new Stations within the FOB[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Station Upgrades:[/b] Unlock additional capabilities across various Stations within the FOB. Further Station upgrades can be accessed via the 3D Printer.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Recipes:[/b] Craft new items at the 3D Printer[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Operator Skins[/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Items:[/b] Unlock the following Items:[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Consumables[/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Survival Kits[/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Fire Support (Killstreaks)[/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]3D Printer Materials[/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Gear[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Level Unlocks Appendix:[/b] For a complete list of every piece of content you’ll unlock while leveling up, see the Multiplayer and DMZ Level Unlocks Appendices at the end of this article.[/p][p][/p][h2]Prestige[/h2][p][i]Career / Progression / Prestige[/i] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0a79e67bf239c3391265c06b8049d8c84456ae8a.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] offers 10 levels of Prestige and 1,000 Prestige Master levels. For the first time in a Call of Duty game, players can now choose from two distinct Prestige paths: Classic Prestige and Regular Prestige.[/p][p][/p][h3]Classic and Regular Prestige[/h3][p]Whether you prefer the traditional reset-and-rebuild structure of Classic Prestige or a more flexible progression path that preserves unlocked content, both systems deliver long-term rewards, progression milestones, and new ways to level up across Multiplayer and beyond.[/p][p] [/p][list][*][p][b]Classic Prestige[/b] delivers the traditional Prestige experience, resetting level unlocks and Create-a-Class progress in exchange for a 20% XP boost, one Permanent Unlock Token, and bonus cosmetic rewards.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Regular Prestige[/b] allows players to restart progression from Level 1 while keeping all level unlocks and Create-a-Class content intact, offering a more flexible progression path.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/786da5701dd750aac2d170733f7b8a5699a0db5d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Upon completing Level 55, you are given the option to choose your Prestige path. Each time you complete a new Prestige Level, you are given the option again to select either the Classic or Regular Track when entering the next Prestige Level.[/p][p]A majority of the Prestige rewards are shared by both Prestige paths, though players on the Classic Track will earn bonus rewards.[/p][p][/p][h3]Permanent Unlocks[/h3][p]Players who select the Classic Prestige Track will earn one Permanent Unlock Token that allows you to permanently unlock a single Level Unlock item of your choice from the available Loadout items.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/25f4c2af0286f891939065d0aa1ac298190ec0bb.jpg"][/img][/p][p]For example, a player enters Prestige 1, having earned a Permanent Unlock Token for selecting the Classic Track. Because their rank is reset to 1, they will have to reach Level 48 again to re-unlock the Throwing Knife. Or they can choose to spend their Permanent Unlock Token on the Throwing Knife, keeping it accessible to them throughout the remainder of their entire leveling journey, even if (and when) they enter Classic Prestige again in the future.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Note:[/b] When choosing which progression item to spend a Permanent Unlock Token on, consider prioritizing Perks, Field Upgrades, Killstreaks, and Equipment over Weapons. Whenever you acquire a Weapon Blueprint from the Store or in a seasonal Battle Pass, the base version of the weapon will become permanently available throughout your entire leveling journey.[/p][p][/p][h3]Modern Warfare 4 Prestige 1 Revealed[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ed68c21edebd15b68533f558397797884f42467f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i], each Prestige Level features content inspired by a different Infinity Ward title. See the Loading Screen reward in each Prestige Level progression track to see that Prestige Level’s point of reference.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7ea5178c59ebe601cc5bd5a67fbaebe0dbd69fb6.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Prestige 1 kicks things off where it all began with rewards inspired by the original [i]Call of Duty[/i] (2003):[/p][p][/p][p][b]Sandstorm[/b][/p][p][i]Operator Skin for Army SF Airborne[/i][/p][p][i]Unlocked at Prestige 1 Instant Reward[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Call of Duty (2003)[/b][/p][p][i]Loading Screen[/i][/p][p][i]Unlocked at Prestige 1 Level 10[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Prestige 1[/b][/p][p][i]Emblem[/i][/p][p][i]Unlocked at Prestige 1 Level 20[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Engage![/b][/p][p][i]Weapon Charm[/i][/p][p][i]Unlocked at Prestige 1 Level 30[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Men of Service[/b][/p][p][i]Large Decal[/i][/p][p][i]Unlocked at Prestige 1 Level 40[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]The Vet / The Vet Prime[/b][/p][p][i]Weapon Blueprint for the Mosin-Nagant Marksman Rifle[/i][/p][p][i]Regular Track: “The Vet” | Classic Track: “The Vet Prime”[/i][/p][p][i]Unlocked at Prestige 1 Level 50[/i][/p][p][/p][h3]Modern Warfare 4 Prestige 2-10[/h3][p]For those committed to the grind with the goal of entering Prestige Master, you’ll first need to climb through all ten Prestige Levels, each one offering a new reward every ten levels. The following notes highlights from each Prestige Level, including the title that inspires each and the final rewards earned in both the Regular and Classic Tracks:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ab97845d3746863f97be59fd296b148879610688.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Prestige 2: Call of Duty 2 (2005)[/b][/p][p][i]Weapon Blueprints for the PPSh-41 SMG[/i][/p][p][i]Regular Track: “Calm Resolve” | Classic Track: “Trench Fiend”[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Prestige 3: Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare (2007)[/b][/p][p][i]Operator Skins for SAS[/i][/p][p][i]Regular Track: “Watchtower” | Classic Track: “Watchtower Prime”[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Prestige 4: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 (2009)[/b][/p][p][i]Weapon Blueprints for the Finn LMG[/i][/p][p][i]Regular Track: “Terminal” | Classic Track: “Torn Up”[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d87e369dcb54f06f7ba85c01fe3219681919166c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Prestige 5: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3 (2011)[/b][/p][p][i]Operator Skins for Army SF Airborne[/i][/p][p][i]Regular Track: “Razor One” | Classic Track: “Razor One Prime”[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Prestige 6: Call of Duty: Ghosts (2013)[/b][/p][p][i]Weapon Blueprints for the Axion Assault Rifle[/i][/p][p][i]Regular Track: “Ghosts Legend” | Classic Track: “Ghosts Legend Prime”[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Prestige 7: Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare (2016)[/b][/p][p][i]Operator Skins for Army SF Airborne[/i][/p][p][i]Regular Track: “Warfighter” | Classic Track: “Warfighter Prime”[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3a301b6aeb9972074eeb8f7e170d25937293f8f6.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Prestige 8: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare (2019)[/b][/p][p][i]Weapon Blueprints for the M4 Assault Rifle[/i][/p][p][i]Regular Track: “141” | Classic Track: “141 Prime”[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Prestige 9: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II (2022)[/b][/p][p][i]Operator Skins for Reece[/i][/p][p][i]Regular Track: “Sable” | Classic Track: “Sable Prime”[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Prestige 10: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4[/b][/p][p][i]Weapon Blueprints for the Sang 9mm Pistol[/i][/p][p][i]Regular Track: “Boksu” | Classic Track: “Boksu Prime”[/i][/p][p][/p][h3]Prestige Master[/h3][p][i]Career / Progression / Prestige Master[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/fb679218ea492999058624cae09fa99d9221029e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]For the hardened vets who manage to progress through all 10 Prestige Levels, the ultimate challenge awaits: Prestige Master. From here on out, your Level will reach beyond 55 all the way to Level 1,000. Earn Prestige Master rewards every five to ten Levels up to Level 99 and then unlock additional rewards every 25 Levels until you reach Level 1,000 and become a Prestige Legend.[/p][p]Expect the Prestige Master rewards you can expect to earn along the way to include the following:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b4912c53b6f34a5559d7a156dd45a7bcc7f92b63.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Prestige Master Instant Reward[/b][/p][p][i]Prestige Master Highlight: “Paragon” Operator Skin | Park[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Other rewards in the Level 56-99 Prestige Master track include:[/p][list][*][p]Prestige Master Instant Reward: Orange Level Color[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Prestige Master Level 60: “Best of the Best” Loading Screen[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Prestige Master Level 65: “Prestige Master 56” Emblem[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Prestige Master Level 70: “Pinnacle” Weapon Charm[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Prestige Master Level 80: “Containment Breach” Weapon Sticker[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Prestige Master Level 90: “Master Renegade” Han 86 Assault Rifle Blueprint[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Prestige Master Level Colors[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9c314dd52b1a459d20a1a63b012fb5902f0b4d2a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Upon entering Prestige Master at Level 56, players will earn their first Level Color customization option, starting with Orange, allowing you to customize your Level Color for other players to see in-game.[/p][p]Reach Level 100 to acquire the Navy option, with more Level Color options unlocking every 25 Prestige Master Levels, including multi-color and animated color options.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Prestige Master Icons[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/92206514e0ea07926d631336f3f235e71a43f8d8.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Beginning at Prestige Master Level 100, and every 100 Levels thereafter on the way to Prestige Legend, players will unlock additional sets of legacy Prestige icons from past Call of Duty games across the entire franchise, including the new Modern Warfare 4 Prestige icons. Equipping one of these Legacy Prestige Icons replaces your current Prestige Master icon.[/p][p]The ultimate rewards for reaching Prestige Legend? Those are \[CLASSIFIED].[/p][p][/p][h2]Weapon Camos[/h2][p][i]Create a Class / Edit Custom Class / Camo Select[/i][/p][p][i]Unlock Camos that can be equipped to your Loadout Weapons in Gunsmith.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0f9920c4a3111c5a9ceff014c42b8ea137cc5611.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i], Weapon Camo progress begins with the basics: level up your weapon. Whether you’re playing Multiplayer or DMZ (and starting at Season 1, [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i]), you’ll begin working your way toward unlocking the initial Military Camos. By tying these Camos to your Weapon Level, you are rewarded no matter what your playstyle.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Tip:[/b] Get an early start on the Weapon Camo grind with the release of DMZ Early Access on October 20 for digital pre-orders and pre-purchases! Level up your weapons and earn Attachments and Camos that will be available in Multiplayer at the game’s official launch on October 23.[/p][p][/p][h3]Military Camos[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/64799f0448770cb5e13ad603ec5f6b6de6b754f4.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Every weapon begins its Camo journey with the Military Camos. There are eight Military Camos in all, each one unlocked sequentially at escalating Weapon Level milestones. Because the Military Camos are tied to Weapon Level, they must be individually unlocked on each weapon. The required Weapon Level to unlock the different Military Camos varies between each weapon, taking its Max maximum Weapon Level into account.[/p][p]Each weapon has individual unlock access to the same eight Military Camos, numbered 1 through 8 (Military Camo 1, Military Camo 2, etc.). As long as you’re using the weapon, you benefit from unlocking Military Camos, granting greater flexibility in how you approach the early Camo grind.[/p][p][/p][p]For example:[/p][p][b]Han 86 Assault Rifle Military Camo Unlock Criteria.[/b] This occurs no matter which game mode you are playing (Multiplayer or DMZ), and you accrue Military Camos as you level up the weapon between 1 and 72. Other weapons have different unlock levels.[/p][list][*][p][b]Military Camo 1:[/b] Reach Weapon Level 10.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Military Camo 2:[/b] Reach Weapon Level 18.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Military Camo 3:[/b] Reach Weapon Level 25.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Military Camo 4:[/b] Reach Weapon Level 34.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Military Camo 5:[/b] Reach Weapon Level 42.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Military Camo 6:[/b] Reach Weapon Level 50.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Military Camo 7:[/b] Reach Weapon Level 57.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Military Camo 8:[/b] Reach Weapon Level 65.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Special Camos[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3d843f9a67e575eb82062d810d19b9d8dec02bb1.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Each weapon additionally features three Special Weapon Camos that are unique to every weapon, and once completed, join a universal pool of Camos accessible to all other weapons. Reach the required Weapon Level to gain access to the Special Camo Challenges, tasking you with combat-specific objectives like landing a certain number of double kills, mounted kills, longshots, headshots, and other gameplay challenges.[/p][p][i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] features a single Weapon Camo grind that is shared across all modes, and the Special Camo Challenges will automatically adjust to the specific mode you are playing. Because non-player targets count in DMZ, Special Camo Challenges typically require a higher kill count in that extraction mode compared to Multiplayer or Call of Duty: Warzone. Once you complete the challenge in any mode, the Special Camo will be available in all modes. Play the mode of your choosing and get rewarded.[/p][p][/p][p]Two examples:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c8e530bc1c4bf685741763f76cf857c4b3346a3a.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Han 86 Assault Rifle Special Camo Unlock Criteria:[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Smoke:[/b] Get player kills while the weapon is Mounted. Challenge unlocked at Weapon Level 25.[/p][list][*][p]20 Kills for Multiplayer.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]75 Kills for DMZ.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Stormwave:[/b] Get player kills while using a silencer. Challenge unlocked at Weapon Level 46.[/p][list][*][p]50 Kills for Multiplayer.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]125 Enemy Kills in DMZ.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Red:[/b] Get player kills with a specific criteria, depending on the mode.. Challenge unlocked at Weapon Level 72 (Max Weapon Level for the Han 86).[/p][list][*][p]3 Player Kills without dying for Multiplayer.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]3 Enemy Kills without taking damage 50 times for DMZ.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Sang 9mm Pistol Special Camo Unlock Criteria:[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Autumn:[/b] Get player kills while Aiming Down Sights. Challenge unlocked at Weapon Level 13.[/p][list][*][p]25 in Multiplayer.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]75 Enemy Kills in DMZ.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Snakeskin:[/b] Get player kills with a specific criterion. Challenge unlocked at Weapon Level 25:[/p][list][*][p]3 Kills without Dying 5 times in Multiplayer.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]3 Enemy Kills without taking damage 15 times in DMZ.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Space Time:[/b] Get player kills using Akimbo. Challenge unlocked at Weapon Level 38 (Max Weapon Level for the Sang 9mm).[/p][list][*][p]50 Player Kills while using Akimbo in Multiplayer.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]125 Enemy Kills while using Akimbo in DMZ.[/p][/*][/list][p]The specific number of eliminations required in each of the above challenges will change based on the mode you are playing. As you unlock Special Camos, your Shared Camo pool will grow, encouraging players to level up a variety of weapons.[/p][p][/p][h3]Completionist Camos[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f573ad40540fc2371b3cb48f4c8b382221d37a2f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Once you have unlocked all eight Military Camos and three Special Camos for a weapon, you gain access to the Completionist Camos. As with Special Camos, Completionist Camos all feature Camo Challenges that the player must fully complete before unlocking the Camo.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Gold Completionist Camo[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/83bb62f6d6e9d75df1cb481fc5a8aa785e5fdd8c.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Complete all Military and Special Camo Challenges to unlock. Then:[/p][list][*][p]Execute 15 eliminations in a single Multiplayer match.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Or 100 eliminations in a DMZ match.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Platinum Completionist Camo[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b9b7ca6ee3aa71ab00077f4d1458f2dd9f2f21c1.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Complete all Gold Camo Challenges in the same weapon class to unlock this challenge. For example, with Assault Rifles, you must have completed 8 Gold Camo Challenges using Assault Rifles before starting on Platinum. All Platinum Camo Challenges are unique per weapon class, as follows:[/p][list][*][p][b]Assault Rifles:[/b] Get Headshots[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]SMGs:[/b] Get Kills from Behind[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Shotguns:[/b] Get Hipfire Kills.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]LMGs:[/b] Get Play Kills without Dying[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Marksman Rifles:[/b] Get Player Kills while Prone[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Sniper Rifles:[/b] Get Player Kills while Prone[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Pistols:[/b] Get Player Kills from Behind[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Launchers:[/b] Get Player Kills without Taking Damage[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Melee:[/b] Get Kills without Dying[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]For example, [b]to unlock the Platinum Camo for the Han 86 Assault Rifle[/b], you would complete all 8 Gold Camo Challenges for all Assault Rifles (including the Han 86), then complete the Platinum Camo Challenge, wholly or partly in Multiplayer or DMZ:[/p][list][*][p][b]Multiplayer:[/b] Get 50 Headshots against Players.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]DMZ:[/b] Get 100 Headshots against Enemies.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Harmonic Break Completionist Camo[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/949acf1e4bb567633227d2d6a1d6629487aabb62.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Complete all the Platinum Camo Challenges before access to the Harmonic Break Camo Challenges is granted. All Like Platinum, all Harmonic Break Camo Challenges are unique per weapon class, as follows:[/p][list][*][p][b]Assault Rifles:[/b] Get Double Kills[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]SMGs:[/b] Get Hipfire Kills[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Shotguns:[/b] Get Player Kills without Reloading[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]LMGs:[/b] Get Player Kills without Releasing the Trigger[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Marksman Rifles:[/b] Get One Shot Kills[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Sniper Rifles:[/b] Get One Shot Kills[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Pistols:[/b] Get Hipfire Kills[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Launchers:[/b] Get Player Kills[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Melee:[/b] Get Player Kills from Behind[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]For example, [b]to unlock the Harmonic Break Camo for the Han 86 Assault Rifle[/b], you would complete all Platinum Camo Challenges for 33 weapons (including the Han 86), then complete the Harmonic Break Camo Challenge, wholly or partly in Multiplayer or DMZ:[/p][list][*][p][b]Multiplayer:[/b] Get 25 Double Kills against Players.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]DMZ:[/b] Get 50 Double Kills against Enemies.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Divergence Completionist Camo[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d680cdce266e8055dcc68139a86e8eb37e854e07.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The Divergence Weapon Camo is awarded for completing 33 Harmonic Break Challenges. Unlocking this Completionist Camo gives players access to the Mastery 1 Camo Challenges.[/p][p][/p][h3]Mode Mastery Camos[/h3][p]For the dedicated weapon specialists who complete all Military, Special, and Completionist Weapon Camo Challenges, the Camo Grind enters its final stage with Mastery Camos. Mastery Camos are game mode specific, with three Multiplayer, three DMZ, and starting in Season 1, three [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] Mastery Camo Challenges. [/p][p]Here’s a more detailed look at each Mastery Camo in Multiplayer and DMZ:[/p][p][/p][h3]Multiplayer Mastery Camos[/h3][p][/p][p][b]Mastery 1: Mercurial Drift Mastery Camo[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6f1bc4a3ef3db30f5aae6b3266552d1c92d4831e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Complete all Harmonic Break Camo Challenges to unlock. [/p][list][*][p]Then get 10 Kills in a match 250 times.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Mastery 2: Polyatomic Reforged Mastery Camo[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b0575b8a04bd83654880066d45075bbf760a6c1a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Gain access to the Mastery 2 Camo Challenge by completing the Mercurial Drift Camo Challenge.[/p][list][*][p]Then get 3 kills without taking Damage 300 times.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Mastery 3: Orion Reforged Mastery Camo[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/637e9760b38eb61754ae7b3b121ba6b79842d11a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Complete the Polyatomic Reforged Camo Challenge to gain access.[/p][list][*][p]Then get 5 Kills without dying 500 times.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]DMZ Mastery Camos[/h3][p][/p][p][b]Mastery 1: Chiral Mastery Camo[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/bfd6b757b2cb93422a8ee51a02985696b08b7bea.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Complete all Harmonic Break Camo Challenges to unlock. [/p][list][*][p]Then Exfil 2 LT dog tags in a single deployment 50 times.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Mastery 3: Helio Mastery Camo[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d58a036a0eaae8b83eeafb2e7bbdff6ef407143c.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Complete the Ripple Tide Mastery Camo Challenge to gain access.[/p][list][*][p]Then get 25,000 Kills using Legendary Weapons on a Max Level Operator.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Call of Duty: Warzone Mastery Camos[/h3][p][/p][p][b]Mastery 1: Parallax Mastery Camo[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9e6208aa292d35842aced042ced73d7527265c4b.jpg"][/img]\[\[CLASSIFIED]] [/p][p][/p][p][b]Mastery 2: Damascus Reforged Mastery Camo[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9ca7d8418ff382190857ebaf6aeb75593ed2c3ea.jpg"][/img]\[\[CLASSIFIED]] [/p][p][/p][p][b]Mastery 3: Empyros Mastery Camo[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e1f92e749a2324d47800ca767c6c21dce10d76c4.jpg"][/img]\[\[CLASSIFIED]] [/p][p][/p][p][b]Note:[/b] Get more intel on [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] Mastery Camos when the classified info above gets revealed in Season 1.[/p][p][/p][h2]Weapon Prestige and Weapon Prestige Camos[/h2][p][i]Create a Class / Edit Custom Class[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/cb6238e776d39c49d3bef8efc3d597f5639df2b0.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Every weapon class in [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] includes an optional Weapon Prestige journey that becomes available after reaching a weapon’s Max Level. There are four Prestige Weapon Camos to earn throughout your weapon Prestige journey, though all are facets of the evolving Weapon Camo called “Pyroclast.”[/p][p][/p][h3]Weapon Leveling[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d3968b8191c65d88293a45a6f419c3a79b48f0c7.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The first part of progression involves leveling up your weapons as normal:[/p][list][*][p][b]Start Leveling:[/b] Use the weapon in Multiplayer and DMZ to earn Weapon XP and level up the weapon.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Unlock Attachments:[/b] Unlock a new Attachment for the weapon every time it gains a level, giving you more options in Gunsmith.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Reach Maximum Weapon Level:[/b] Once your weapon reaches Max Level, you are given the option to enter into Weapon Prestige.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Weapon Prestige 1[/h3][p][/p][p]Once you reach Max Level with your weapon, you can choose to enter Weapon Prestige. When entering Weapon Prestige, the following occurs:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ca4028635603a15d54c0c90caa97151c23e5e65f.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Level and Attachment Reset:[/b] Reset your Weapon Level back to 1 and relock all attachments except for Apex Attachments and Weapon Blueprint Attachments.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]New Icon:[/b] A new Weapon Prestige icon will appear in Gunsmith and on the Killcam.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Prestiging a weapon does not relock Shared Attachments on other weapons.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Weapon Customization (Blueprints, Camos, Reticles, Accessories, Decals, and Stickers) are maintained and not reset when Prestiging your Weapon.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Pyroclast Camo[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8dabce0870d488ea167de23376ab900b370b3d05.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Unlock Criteria: Reach Weapon Prestige 1 Level 1.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Pyroclast Terminus Camo[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/400a41bc939c9fb123a46253154ca5a399b8a9e7.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Unlock Criteria: Reach Weapon Prestige 1 Max Level.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3]Weapon Prestige Master[/h3][p]Once you’ve reached Max Level again in Weapon Prestige 1, you will automatically enter into Master Prestige. The Weapon Level does not reset to 1 and you keep all earned attachments. Instead, you will continue to gain Weapon Levels earning up to two Prestige Master Camos. Entering Weapon Prestige Master also unlocks a new Weapon Prestige Master icon in Gunsmith and viewable in the Killcam.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Pyroclast Scatter Camo[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d7e071666372a3f070f0761e2d855fc01e9b185f.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Unlock Criteria: Reach Weapon Prestige Master Level 150.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Pyroclast Cascade Camo[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/98c6aa762b837698e4147d95612547baa51abe10.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Unlock Criteria: Reach Weapon Prestige Master Level 250.[/i] [/p][p][/p][p]The [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Weapon Prestige system offers deep progression with every weapon, rewarding your efforts along the way as you gain total mastery over your favorite armaments. To speed up the process, activate earned Double Weapon XP Tokens throughout the weapon leveling process.[/p][p][/p][h2]Reticle Challenges[/h2][p][i]Create a Class > Edit Custom Class > Gunsmith > Appearance > Reticle Select[/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] features multiple styles of Optic Attachments, including the Mini Reflex, Reflex, Holo, 4x Scope, Marksman Scope, and Rifle Scope, with thermal and non-thermal options for Holo, 4x Scope, Marksman Scope, and Rifle Scope Optics. Each Optic Attachment you equip features multiple unlockable Reticles, including color variations. Here’s how the process works:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6813d1d0eff4581134614732dc6157da675bd480.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Step 1:[/b] Gain access to Reticle Challenges by first equipping an unlocked Optic Attachment to your Weapon. Optics are unlocked at certain Weapon Level milestones. Check a weapon’s Progression tab in Gunsmith for more intel.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Step 2:[/b] Once you’ve equipped an Optic, head to the “Appearance > Reticle” section of the Gunsmith menu to view the unlockable Reticles for the equipped Optic.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Step 3:[/b] Earn the required number of eliminations while aiming down sights to unlock the next Reticle.[/p][/*][/list][p]Some Reticles include multiple color variants of the same design. All associated color variants will unlock at the same time.[/p][p][/p][p]Progress is universal across all modes, whether you’re playing Multiplayer, DMZ, or starting in Season 1, [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i]. Once you’ve unlocked a Reticle on a specific Optic, it will be available on that Optic in all modes. Reticle unlock progress is specific to each individual Optic Attachment, but because the vast majority of Optics are Shared Attachments, you will be able to continue making Reticle unlock progress on all compatible weapons.[/p][p][/p][h2]Daily Challenges[/h2][p][i]Career > Challenges[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/77d209298dd9ceaade0bde01315624547a8f4254.jpg"][/img]Complete Daily Challenges in Multiplayer to earn XP payouts that will help you move more quickly through the Player Level track. Complete all three Daily Challenges to earn a hefty XP bonus. At the start of Season 1, complete an additional set of Daily Challenges in [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i].[/p][p]Reroll: Once per day, players can reroll one of the three available Daily Challenges. A new Daily Challenge will be chosen to replace it, giving you some control over your playstyle for the day. [/p][p][/p][h2]Calling Card Challenges[/h2][p][i]Career / Challenges / Calling Cards[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/65b9e7b4126e277b79949732de7f82d6680f5ed7.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Earn hundreds of Calling Cards to show off your prowess across game modes and in different combat situations. At launch, Calling Card Challenges are sorted into the following categories:[/p][p][/p][h3]Regular Calling Card Challenges[/h3][p][b]Multiplayer Mastery:[/b] Objective, War, Capture Zone, Bomb, Cash, Dog Tag[/p][p][b]DMZ Mastery:[/b] Combat, Mission, Exfil, Loot, Exploration, FOB[/p][p][b]Shared Mode Mastery:[/b] Combat, Loadout, Collection, Mobility Course[/p][p][/p][h3]Elite Calling Card Challenges[/h3][p][b]Elite Multiplayer Mastery:[/b] Ground Zero, Winner, Melee, Executions[/p][p][b]Elite DMZ Mastery:[/b] Final Showdown, High-Value Escort, King Slayer, Exterminator[/p][p][b]Elite Campaign Mastery:[/b] Veteran Completer, Realism Completer, YOLO Completer[/p][p][/p][h3]Calling Card Categories, Sets, and Cards[/h3][p][/p][p]Each of the different Mastery categories features its own collection of Mastery Sets to complete. For example, win 20/60/150/300 Multiplayer Matches to unlock all four Calling Cards in the Victorious! Tiered Challenge of the Objective Mastery Set. The different Calling Cards in a Tiered Challenge share the same general design but are presented with different colors and styles.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Check Your Progress[/b][/p][p]Check the right side of the screen for progress details while searching through the various Calling Card Mastery Sets and Challenges. When selecting a Mastery Set, you will see your progress for all related Sets or Challenges required to complete that Mastery Set. When selecting a specific Calling Card Challenge within a Mastery Set, you will see your current progress for that Challenge.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Tracked & Near Complete[/b][/p][p]Head to the Tracked & Near Complete tab in the Calling Card Challenges menu for a quick overview of your progress across up to nine tracked Challenges as well as insight into Challenges you are close to completing. When browsing through different Challenges, simply press the displayed button to Add to Tracked.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8293cdb9237a1a834deae23773858c85bc299f65.jpg"][/img][i]A showcase of DMZ Calling Cards.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Complete Them All for Mastery[/b][/p][p]Complete all the Challenges within a Mastery Set to unlock an animated Mastery Calling Card. Get a complete list of every weapon including detailed weapon stats and unlock criteria.[/p][p]In Multiplayer, Create-a-Class customization unlocks at Player Level 4; before that point, choose from a variety of premade Default Loadouts to deploy with.[/p][p]In DMZ, any weapon or Attachment you’ve unlocked or leveled up in Multiplayer or DMZ can be accessed in the Forward Operating Base Gunsmith station and equipped providing you have the DMZ Cash funds to purchase it. Weapons can also be acquired by looting during a deployment, constructed with a Weapon Manual found in Hajin, or purchased from the FOB Vendor.[/p][p] [/p][p](*[i]Call of Duty: Warzone™[/i] content integration arrives in Season 1 later this year.)[/p][p][/p][h3]Weapons Overview[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f8e277133a8efa59c6bdf422b3783d000e8aaffd.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Primary Weapons (24):[/b] [/p][p]Your main damage-dealing armament. Primary Weapons each come with individual Attachments that are unlocked as you level up the weapon. In Modern Warfare 4, each Attachment is unlocked only once, meaning that once unlocked, the same Attachment will be available across all weapons that use it.[/p][p]Access Gunsmith to adjust each Primary Weapon with Attachments suited to your playstyle, to change its Appearance, and check its Progression. [/p][p]In Multiplayer, equip the “Overkill” Perk if you plan to use another Primary Weapon in your loadout, taking the place of your Secondary Weapon. [/p][p]In DMZ, you are free to carry two Primary, two Secondary, or one of each type of weapon into a DMZ match, and additional weapons if you have a specific Weapon Backpack type.[/p][p][/p][p]Expect the following Primary Weapon classes:[/p][list][*][p]Assault Rifles (8)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Submachine Guns (SMGs) (5)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Shotguns (2)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]LMGs (3)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Marksman Rifles (3)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Sniper Rifles (3)[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Secondary Weapons (8):[/b][/p][p]Swap to this back-up weapon when your Primary Weapon runs out of ammo or needs reloading. Equip Pistols to face enemy Operators or a Launcher to take out vehicles, Killstreaks, and Operators. Gunsmith is available for Pistols, while Launchers can only change their Appearance (Camos, Decals, and Stickers). There are two types of Secondary Weapons:[/p][list][*][p]Pistols (4)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Launchers (4)[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Melee Weapons (1):[/b] [/p][p]For use in close-quarter battles at melee range. Unsheathe your Melee Weapon by pressing and holding the melee button. In Multiplayer, equip the “Lethal Reach” Perk to automatically use your Melee Weapon attack when performing a weapon butt by pressing the melee button. Melee Weapons only change their Appearance (Camos). [/p][p]When adding Attachments to a weapon or comparing your weapon to other weapons, Gunsmith displays values for [b]Damage, Range, Accuracy, Mobility, and Handling[/b]. Players can dive deeper into weapon statistics by pulling up the Details menu.[/p][p][/p][h3]Attachments Overview[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7d5956f74ed528e8882a6978325f51275c185b2e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Every Primary Weapon, plus Pistols, can be outfitted with Attachments which alter the weapon’s performance. Select individual Attachments to view their description plus a list of associated Pros and Cons. Attachment types include:[/p][list][*][p][b]Optics:[/b] Improve target acquisition with a variety of sights, helping you line up shots more effectively.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Lasers:[/b] Tighten hip-fire spread, support a Canted Stance, highlight enemies, and provide other close-quarters aiming benefits, though some lasers may reveal your position.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Barrels:[/b] Adjust a Weapon's damage range, bullet velocity, and other ballistic characteristics.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Muzzles:[/b] Reduce recoil, suppress weapon fire, or otherwise refine shot control and weapon accuracy.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Underbarrels:[/b] Enhance recoil control and aiming stability or equip specialized launcher attachments where available.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Stocks:[/b] Boost mobility, accuracy, flinch resistance, or handling related handling traits.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Rear Grips:[/b] Adjust weapon handling, including Aim Down Sight (ADS) and Sprint-to-Fire speeds.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Comb:[/b] Adjust handling statistics including ADS and Sprint-to-Fire speeds, Flinch Resistance, and ADS Idle Sway.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Ammunition:[/b] Modify your weapon's rounds to alter ballistic performance, adding specialized effects or enhancing attributes like bullet velocity, damage range, or penetration.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Magazines:[/b] Increase ammunition capacity or improve reload efficiency to keep you in the fight longer.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]Infinity Ward has introduced some changes to the way Attachments are earned in [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i]:[/p][list][*][p]Each Attachment is only unlocked once, meaning there is no redundant grinding. The same Attachment is available across all weapons that use it, once unlocked the first time.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Each weapon can unlock all Attachments available to it.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Players do not have to utilize a different weapon to earn an Attachment on their favorite gun(s).[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Grow your arsenal: The more attachments you unlock, the more that become immediately available when you start to use a new weapon.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Weapon Progression Speed: If you reach a level on a weapon that would award you an Attachment you already own, you skip that level with a Bonus Level Up.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Apex Attachments[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d9d366e9724c10c8049d728b67254d9b81a2bc06.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Apex Attachments introduce a new tier of optional weapon customization, unlocked as the final reward for fully leveling a supported weapon. Equipped separately from standard Gunsmith Attachments, they don't consume an attachment slot, allowing you to further specialize your favorite weapons without changing your existing build.[/p][p]Rather than offering incremental stat adjustments, Apex Attachments fundamentally change how a weapon performs. Some transform familiar platforms into entirely new combat roles, while others introduce alternate fire modes, integrated equipment, or specialized tactical capabilities unavailable through standard Gunsmith customization.[/p][p]Every supported weapon has its own unique Apex Attachment, encouraging experimentation and rewarding players who master the arsenal.[/p][p][/p][h3]Gunny: Attachment Optimizer[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/382da37b7ee8e3fa4ddb5310c097108be8a36da0.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Available within Create-a-Class and the DMZ FOB Gunsmith, Gunny uses the Attachments you’ve already unlocked to craft suggested weapon builds, allowing players to experiment with different weapon characteristics, ranges, and combat roles without slowing down customization.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f3a69278541abd5b76d6eaad64992eabfb3d550d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]With a single input, Gunny can cycle through builds that support different playstyles such as close-range, balanced, or long-range, and these builds evolve naturally as new Attachments are unlocked, supporting weapon progression from early levels through full completion.[/p][p][/p][h3]Firing Range[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/be9c99de5bd700c0e37ef5cf45376e1f1361ef31.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Every Weapon category offers its own strengths, handling characteristics, and role within a Multiplayer match. Visit either of the Firing Ranges (one for Multiplayer, one in the DMZ FOB) at any time to compare Weapon builds, test Attachments, and evaluate performance before deploying into a match. [/p][p][/p][p]In the Multiplayer Firing Range, bench test your weapons with a variety of features including: [/p][list][*][p]Stats tracking in the top-left corner of your screen confirming targets killed, your accuracy, damage, moving target range, and TTK.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Practice dummies at 10-, 25-, 50-, and 100-meter intervals, with the ability to add one, two, or three plates to them.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Cycle through your Loadouts without leaving the Firing Range (Multiplayer only).[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Toggle between a moving target (allowing you to hit the same target at three different ranges) or recoil plate (excellent for viewing bullet spread and recoil patterns).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Equipment Details: Tacticals, Lethals, Field Upgrades, Killstreaks[/h2][p]Get a detailed look at the various gear options supported in both Create-a-Class and the DMZ 3D Printer, including Tactical and Lethal Equipment, Field Upgrades, and Killstreaks.[/p][p]Note: Multiplayer equipment is listed. range of tactical benefits, from disorienting enemies to disabling electronics, gathering intel, topping off your health, and more. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/bbb83386e1b72767a9ec47fd17435f3f01c396e2.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The following Tactical items will be available at launch:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Flash Grenade[/b][/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 4.[/p][p][i]Blinds and deafens targets.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Smoke Grenade[/b][/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 4.[/p][p][i]Smoke screen that blocks vision and automated targeting systems. Weapon fire and explosions rip through the coverage.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Snapshot Grenade[/b][/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 10.[/p][p][i]Provides a momentary glimpse of enemies within the immediate area for your team.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Concussion Grenade[/b][/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 15.[/p][p][i]Disorients enemies, resulting in reduced reaction speeds and blurred vision.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Heartbeat Sensor[/b][/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 23.[/p][p][i]Battery-powered tablet that displays nearby enemy locations.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Shock Stick[/b][/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 29.[/p][p][i]Electrical device that sticks to surfaces, electrocutes enemies, destroys equipment, and causes vehicles to go haywire.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Decoy Grenade[/b][/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 42.[/p][p][i]Counter-intel grenade that stimulates gunfire, movement, and radar signatures to confuse the enemy.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Stim[/b][/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 47.[/p][p][i]Military stimulant that immediately starts health regeneration and refreshes Tactical Sprint. Mitigates flash and stun effects.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Screamer Mine[/b][/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 53.[/p][p][i]Proximity-triggered mine that suppresses and marks all enemies in range.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3]Lethals (11)[/h3][p][/p][p]Limited per-life items that damage or eliminate enemy Operators. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/41e1bb82554c0415a952864d92de91c8cc284031.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The following Lethal items will be available at launch:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Frag Grenade[/b][/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 4.[/p][p][i]Cookable fragmentation grenade.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Sticky Grenade[/b][/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 4.[/p][p][i]Timed sticky grenade.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Drill Charge[/b][/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 7.[/p][p][i]Thermal lance that burrows through surfaces before releasing an explosive round.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Proximity Mine[/b][/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 13.[/p][p][i]Proximity-triggered explosive that launches and detonates in the air. Can also stick to vehicles that pass over it before exploding.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Zip Gun[/b][/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 17.[/p][p][i]3D printed, single-use pistol that can be quickly deployed to take out close ranged targets.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Trip Wire[/b][/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 22.[/p][p][i]Thrown explosive trap that deploys a detonation wire upon landing. Multiple Trip Wires can link together, creating a connected network of explosives.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Thermite[/b][/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 26.[/p][p][i]Sticky incendiary device that deals heavy damage to vehicles and armored targets.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Molotov Cocktail[/b][/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 28.[/p][p][i]Improvised incendiary device that explodes on impact, leaving flammable pools in the area.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Claymore[/b][/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 37.[/p][p][i]Proximity-activated explosive mine.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]C4[/b][/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 43.[/p][p][i]Large explosive that sticks to surfaces and can be detonated remotely.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Throwing Knife[/b][/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 49.[/p][p][i]Retrievable throwing knife that’s lethal on impact.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3]Field Upgrades (12)[/h3][p][/p][p]These are powerful devices that recharge during the match after use. They perform a variety of useful functions including defensive and offensive support.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0d09cee4b584579fddd0a6ca5bad9b402bc427f9.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The following Field Upgrades available at launch:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Portable Radar[/b][/p][p][b]Recharge Speed:[/b] Medium[/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 4.[/p][p][i]Emits a periodic radar ping to detect nearby enemies.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]DDOS[/b][/p][p][b]Recharge Speed:[/b] Fast[/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 4.[/p][p][i]Emits a localized pulse that temporarily jams and disables nearby enemy electronics and sensors.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Munitions Box[/b][/p][p][b]Recharge Speed:[/b] Medium[/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 6.[/p][p][i]Deploy a box of ammo and equipment for you and your teammates.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]SAM Airburst Turret[/b][/p][p][b]Recharge Speed:[/b] Slow[/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 8.[/p][p][i]Portable missile turret that incinerates aerial threats.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Riot Shield[/b][/p][p][b]Recharge Speed:[/b] Medium[/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 11.[/p][p][i]Destructible shield that can be planted to provide cover for your team.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Trophy System[/b][/p][p][b]Recharge Speed:[/b] Fast[/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 14.[/p][p][i]Deployable defense system that destroys up to three airborne projectiles. Larger targets will take multiple shots to counter.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Seeker Drone[/b][/p][p][b]Recharge Speed:[/b] Slow[/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 19.[/p][p][i]Deployable drone that seeks out nearby enemies to snapshot them.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Inflatable Decoy[/b][/p][p][b]Recharge Speed:[/b] Medium[/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 25.[/p][p][i]Proximity activated decoy dummy. Upon activation, the reinforced fiber target is violently deployed to confuse and distract. Also supports manual activation.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Smoke Wall[/b][/p][p][b]Recharge Speed:[/b] Medium[/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 29.[/p][p][i]Hand-held rocket that emits a long trail of heavy smoke coverage.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Recon Drone[/b][/p][p][b]Recharge Speed:[/b] Slow[/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 33.[/p][p][i]Remote-controlled drone that has manual and auto marking capabilities.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Razor Wire Trap[/b][/p][p][b]Recharge Speed:[/b] Medium[/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 41.[/p][p][i]Proximity activated mine that ensnares enemies in a mesh of barbed wire.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Tactical Insertion[/b][/p][p][b]Recharge Speed:[/b] Medium[/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 45.[/p][p][i]Mark a location to act as your next spawn point.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3]Killstreaks (17)[/h3][p][/p][p]These are the heavy hitters, earned in Multiplayer for both kills and objective play. Kills remain the primary driver, while playing the objective also counts toward your progress. In Modern Warfare 4 Multiplayer, each loadout includes its own attached Killstreaks. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/bf6ce0caaa2dda512c230e4296edd3f489a06cb9.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The following Killstreaks will be available at launch:[/p][p][/p][p][b]UAV[/b][/p][p][b]Kill Requirement:[/b] 4[/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 4.[/p][p][i]UAV recon ship that reveals enemy locations on the minimap.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Bomb Glider[/b][/p][p][b]Kill Requirement:[/b] 4[/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 6.[/p][p][i]Hand-held glider with an explosive payload.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Care Package[/b][/p][p][b]Kill Requirement:[/b] 4 [/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 9.[/p][p][i]Call in a random Killstreak care package to your location.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Impact Warhead[/b][/p][p][b]Kill Requirement:[/b] 4[/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 12.[/p][p][i]Explosive payload that drills through multiple floors.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Artillery Beacon[/b][/p][p][b]Kill Requirement:[/b] 6[/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 4.[/p][p][i]Call in heat seeking missiles that track the deployed beacon.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Crossfire[/b][/p][p][b]Kill Requirement:[/b] 6[/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 20.[/p][p][i]Call in dual airstrikes to annihilate enemies from both directions.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Combat Drone[/b][/p][p][b]Kill Requirement:[/b] 6[/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 26.[/p][p][i]Remote controlled anti-personnel drone.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Counter UAV[/b][/p][p][b]Kill Requirement:[/b] 6 [/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 31.[/p][p][i]A drone that scrambles all enemy minimaps.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Wheelson[/b][/p][p][b]Kill Requirement:[/b] 8[/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 16.[/p][p][i]AI controlled vehicle that hunts down nearby targets or guards the area around the owner.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Missile Salvo[/b] [/p][p][b]Kill Requirement:[/b] 8[/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 24.[/p][p][i]Aerial missile platform that fires lock on missiles.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Railgun Sentry[/b] [/p][p][b]Kill Requirement:[/b] 8 [/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 38.[/p][p][i]Electromagnetic cannon that fires tungsten flechette rounds at hypersonic velocity. Deployable as an autonomous sentry.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Attack Helicopter[/b] [/p][p][b]Kill Requirement:[/b] 10 [/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 4.[/p][p][i]Overwatch helicopter that provides overhead support and target tracking.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Deathstalker[/b] [/p][p][b]Kill Requirement:[/b] 10 [/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 35.[/p][p][i]Remote controlled helicopter with twin mounted turrets that overheat.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Advanced UAV[/b][/p][p][b]Kill Requirement:[/b] 10 [/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 40.[/p][p][i]Orbital UAV that reveals the enemy’s direction on the minimap in real time. Immune to lock-on capabilities.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Argonaut[/b] [/p][p][b]Kill Requirement:[/b] 10[/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 45.[/p][p][i]Equip heavy assault armor with a pump action cluster grenade launcher and burst fire sidearm.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Gunship[/b][/p][p][b]Kill Requirement:[/b] 12 [/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 51.[/p][p][i]Heavy assault gunship equipped with 105mm, 40mm, and 25mm cannons.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Air Lockdown[/b] [/p][p][b]Kill Requirement:[/b] 12[/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 55.[/p][p][i]Call in a series of bombing runs with additional anti-aerial coverage while active.[/i][/p][p][/p][h2]Perks[/h2][p][/p][h3]Multiplayer Perks (18)[/h3][p][/p][p]Perks in Multiplayer return to a streamlined Pick 3 System built around tactical readability and clear combat roles. Perks enhance your loadout by offering a variety of advantages, including Perks that affect your offensive, defensive, stealth, and other vital capabilities in the field. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/bf5b6ad5daf2aa9996b85dc0b8cd694fba33d62a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The following Perks will be available at launch:[/p][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][th][p]Main Player Levels (1-55): Perk 1 Category Unlock Criteria[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p]Level 4: Quick Fix[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Level 4: Overkill[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Level 8: High Alert[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Level 24: Ghost[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Level 31: Resupply[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Level 48: Kill Chain[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][th][p]Player Levels: Perk 2 Category Unlock Criteria[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p]Level 4: Hardline[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Level 4: Blood Rush[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Level 16: Bomb Squad[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Level 20: Fast Hands[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Level 30: Ninja[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Level 40: Birdseye[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][th][p]Player Levels: Perk 3 Category Unlock Criteria[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p]Level 4: Lethal Reach[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Level 4: Combat Grid[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Level 12: Battle Hardened[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Level 28: Scavenger[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Level 32: Tracker[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Level 36: Cold-Blooded[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][h3]Perk 1 Category (6)
[/h3][p][b]Quick Fix[/b]
[b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 4.
[i]Killing players and capturing or holding objectives immediately triggers health regeneration.[/i]

[b]Overkill[/b]
[b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 4.
[i]Carry two primary weapons.[/i]

[b]High Alert[/b]
[b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 8.
[i]Vision pulses when spotted by an enemy player outside of view.[/i]

[b]Ghost[/b]
[b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 24.
[i]Undetectable by Enemy Callouts, UAVs, Portable Radars, and Heartbeat Sensors.[/i]

[b]Resupply[/b]
[b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 31.
[i]Equipment recharges over time and maximum capacity is increased by 1. Field Upgrade earn rate increased.[/i]

[b]Kill Chain[/b]
[b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 48.
[i]Kills from Killstreaks and award half streak points.[/i]

[/p][h3]Perk 2 Category (6)
[/h3][p][b]Hardline[/b]
[b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 4.
[i]Reduce Killstreak cost by 1.[/i]

[b]Blood Rush[/b]
[b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 4.
[i]Enables Tactical Sprint for a burst of speed. Kills replenish your stamina.[/i]

[b]Bomb Squad[/b]
[b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 16.
[i]Take reduced damage from non-Killstreak explosives. Reset fuse timers when picking up live grenades. Immune to Knockdown.[/i]

[b]Fast Hands[/b]
[b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 20.
[i]Reload, use equipment, and swap weapons faster.[/i]

[b]Ninja[/b]
[b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 30.
[i]Your footsteps are quieter, with significantly reduced range.[/i]

[b]Birdseye[/b]
[b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 40.
[i]Zoomed out minimap. UAV and Radar pings reveal the enemy’s direction.[/i]

[/p][h3]Perk 3 Category (6)
[/h3][p][b]Lethal Reach[/b]
[b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 4.
[i]Throw equipment farther with a visible trajectory. Automatically use your dedicated melee attack when you perform a weapon butt.[/i]

[b]Combat Grid[/b]
[b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 4.
[i]Spot enemy Equipment, Field Upgrades, Killstreaks, and vehicles through walls. Friendly players are also highlighted.[/i]

[b]Battle Hardened[/b]
[b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 12.
[i]Reduce the effect of enemy Tacticals.[/i]

[b]Scavenger[/b]
[b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 28.
[i]Enemies drop a retrievable ammo cache on death. Launcher ammo is not included.[/i]

[b]Tracker[/b]
[b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 32.
[i]Enemies leave behind a footprint trail and their Death markers become visible. Kill markers are hidden.[/i]

[b]Cold-Blooded[/b]
[b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 36.
[i]Undetectable by AI Targeting Systems, Thermal Optics, Recon Drones, Spotter Scopes, Snapshot Grenades, and High Alert.[/i][/p][h2]
Pre-order Modern Warfare 4 Today[/h2][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8d9855b2f5ac33ba6fc7d81d510aed0f58c23456.jpg"][/img]
Stay tuned to the latest official [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] information by checking the [url="https://www.callofduty.com/blog"]Call of Duty Blog[/url] through launch and beyond.[/p][p] [/p][p]Pre-orders are [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4435490/Call_of_Duty_Modern_Warfare_4/"]available now on Steam[/url].[/p]

newsitems.contents: [p]Hello, PUBG Esports fans![/p][p align="start"]The final stretch of the 2026 PUBG Global Series is approaching: [b]PGS Circuit 4[/b]. With PGS 10, PGS 11, and the Circuit Final, PGS 12, the three remaining tournaments will bring this year’s 12-event PUBG Global Series to a close.[/p][p align="start"]Circuit 4 is more than just the final circuit of the season. With the conclusion of PGS 12, the [b]final PGS Points standings for the 2026 season will be determined, deciding the eight teams that will advance to PUBG Global Championship 2026.[/b][/p][p align="start"]After three circuits of competition, the race for PGC is beginning to take shape—but nothing has been decided yet. With PGS 10, PGS 11, and double points on the line at PGS 12, there are still [b]240 PGS Points[/b] up for grabs.[/p][p align="start"]Which teams will earn their way to PGC 2026 through PGS Points? Let’s take a closer look at [b]Circuit 4, the final competition of the 2026 PGS season.[/b][/p][p align="start"][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20261007/QYvMFGPC.png" style="border-style: none; max-width: 100%; position: relative; display: block; float: none; margin: 5px auto; vertical-align: top;"][/img][/p][h2][b]PGS Circuit 4 Schedule[/b][/h2][p align="start"]PGS Circuit 4 will take place from [b]October 14 to November 1[/b].[/p][list][*][p][b]PGS 10[/b][/p][list][*][p]Group Stage: October 14[/p][/*][*][p]Winners Stage: October 15[/p][/*][*][p]Survival Stage: October 16[/p][/*][*][p]Final Stage: October 17–18[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]PGS 11[/b][/p][list][*][p]Winners Stage: October 22[/p][/*][*][p]Survival Stage: October 23[/p][/*][*][p]Final Stage: October 24–25[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]PGS 12[/b][/p][list][*][p]Survival Stage: October 29[/p][/*][*][p]Grand Finals: October 30–November 1[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"]As the [b]Circuit Final[/b], PGS 12 will see the top eight teams in the Circuit 4 PGS Points standings advance directly to the Grand Finals based on the points accumulated through PGS 10 and PGS 11. The remaining 16 teams will compete in the Survival Stage for the remaining spots in the Grand Finals.[/p][p align="start"]When PGS 12 comes to an end, it will mark not only the conclusion of Circuit 4, but also the end of the [b]2026 season-long PGS Points race spanning PGS 1 through PGS 12.[/b][/p][p align="start"][b][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20261007/dfU4pJIb.png" style="border-style: none; max-width: 100%; position: relative; display: block; float: none; margin: 5px auto; vertical-align: top;"][/img][/b] [/p][h2][b]PGS Points Standings[/b][/h2][p align="start"]With three circuits and nine PGS events now complete, the battle for PGS Points is more intense than ever.[/p][p align="start"]At the conclusion of Circuit 3, [b]Virtus.pro leads the standings with 261 points[/b], followed by Made in Thailand with 224 points, 17Gaming with 223 points, and T1 with 208 points.[/p][p align="start"]Currently occupying the final PGC qualification spot is [b]Petrichor Road in eighth place with 152 points.[/b][/p][p align="start"]But the gaps around the cutoff remain narrow. Seventh-place Falcons sit just two points ahead at 154, while ninth-place Gen.G Esports trail the current PGC qualification line by only seven points with 145.[/p][p align="start"]Most importantly, [b]Circuit 4 is still to come.[/b] The current standings are far from the final picture of who will advance to PGC.[/p][p align="start"] [img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20261007/WQDtO1dg.png" style="border-style: none; max-width: 100%; position: relative; display: block; float: none; margin: 5px auto; vertical-align: top;"][/img][/p][h2][b]PGC 2026 Qualification & PGS Points[/b][/h2][p align="start"]The [b]top eight teams in the final PGS Points standings[/b], accumulated across PGS 1 through PGS 12 during the 2026 season, will qualify for PGC 2026.[/p][p align="start"]And the final standings determine more than just qualification. The higher a team finishes in the PGS Points standings, the [b]later the stage from which they will begin their PGC 2026 journey.[/b][/p][p align="start"]The team finishing [b]1st in PGS Points will advance directly to the PGC 2026 Grand Finals[/b]. The [b]2nd-place team will enter at Survival Stage Day 1[/b], while the teams finishing [b]3rd through 8th will begin their journey in the Qualifying Stage[/b].[/p][p align="start"]This means Circuit 4 is about more than simply breaking into the Top 8. For teams already inside the qualification zone, the battle will continue until the very end as they fight for a higher PGS Points ranking and a more advantageous PGC seed.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]240 PGS Points Are Still Up for Grabs[/b][/p][p align="start"]In both [b]PGS 10 and PGS 11[/b], the winner will earn [b]60 PGS Points[/b], with points awarded down through 16th place.[/p][p align="start"]At the Circuit Final, [b]PGS 12, the points will be doubled[/b]. The winner will earn 120 points, with 96 points going to second place, and double the PGS 10 and PGS 11 point values applied throughout the standings.[/p][p align="start"]That means the maximum number of points a single team can earn in Circuit 4 is:[/p][p align="start"][b]60 points (PGS 10 1st) + 60 points (PGS 11 1st) + 120 points (PGS 12 1st) = 240 points.[/b][/p][p align="start"]Considering the current gaps both inside and outside the PGC qualification zone, the three remaining tournaments leave plenty of room for the final standings to change.[/p][p align="start"]For teams outside the Top 8, Circuit 4 represents one final opportunity to make their move. For those already inside, it will be the final test to defend their position and secure a higher PGC seed.[/p][p align="start"][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20261012/lwSlSIQk.png" style="border-style: none; max-width: 100%; position: relative; display: block; float: none; margin: 5px auto; vertical-align: top;"][/img][/p][h2][b]PGS 10 Groups[/b][/h2][p align="start"]And it all begins with [b]PGS 10[/b].[/p][p align="start"]The Group Stage groups have been confirmed for the 24 teams competing in PGS 10. The teams have been divided into Groups A, B, and C through a [b]snake seeding format based on the final results of PGS 9.[/b][/p][p align="start"]PGS 9 winner Gen.G Esports has been placed in Group A, second-place T1 in Group B, and third-place Falcons in Group C. From there, the direction of placement alternates according to the PGS 9 standings, distributing all 24 teams across the three groups.[/p][list][*][p][b]Group A:[/b] Gen.G Esports, Made in Thailand, Virtus.pro, TEAM LIQUID, DN SOOPers, Sharper Esports, Team Vitality, Natus Vincere[/p][/*][*][p][b]Group B:[/b] T1, Alpha Gaming, Team Flash, eArena, Petrichor Road, FULL SENSE, TYLOO, JD Gaming[/p][/*][*][p][b]Group C:[/b] Falcons, Geekay Esports, Anyone’s Legend, 17Gaming, FOUR ANGRY MEN, Twisted Minds, 09(Team Nemesis at PGS 9), Godlike[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p align="start"][b]\[Updated: October 12][/b][/p][p align="start"]Following GAM The Expendables’ withdrawal from PGS Circuit 4, Team Flash has been selected as the replacement team based on its placement in PVS Phase 1, in accordance with the existing team qualification criteria.[/p][p align="start"][i]※ Further updates will be provided if there are any changes to the tournament.[/i][/p][/td][/tr][/table][/*][/list][h2][b]The Final Step to PGC[/b][/h2][p align="start"]The 2026 PUBG Global Series journey that began with PGS 1 now has just three tournaments remaining.[/p][p align="start"]There is still everything to play for after Circuit 3. With 60 points available at each of PGS 10 and PGS 11, followed by 120 points at PGS 12, [b]a total of 240 points remain on the table—and a single strong finish could reshape the race to PGC.[/b][/p][p align="start"]Which teams will finish inside the final Top 8 and earn their place at PGC 2026? And which team will rise to the very top of the standings to secure a direct seed to the [b]PGC Grand Finals[/b]?[/p][p align="start"]The final competition of the [b]2026 PUBG Global Series[/b] is about to begin.[/p][p align="start"][b]Tune in and cheer on your favorite teams as they make their final push toward PGC 2026![/b][/p]

newsitems.title: Team Fortress 2 Update Released
newsitems.author: erics
newsitems.contents:
An update to Team Fortress 2 has been released. The update will be applied automatically when you restart Team Fortress 2. The major changes include:

[list]
[*]Fixed some maps not tracking play time correctly
[*]Fixed alpha channel for the updated Cozy Camper backpack image
[*]Updated cp_holyhell[list]
[*]Fixed BLU side skybox not rendering for users with HDR enabled
[*]Improved RED side art pass
[*]Improved middle point art pass
[*]Spells get enabled and respawn permanently on the side of the team that loses middle. This can go both ways.
[*]Lowered round timer to 5 minutes
[*]After 5 minutes of any team capturing middle, instead of a stalemate, every spell gets turned into a rare variant and respawn extremely quickly. After a point gets captured in the stalemate state, the spells return back to normal.
[*]Lowered respawn wave times
[*]Gargoyles now only spawn near middle
[*]Better optimization[/list]
[*]Updated Updated zi_atoll, zi_blazehattan, zi_devastation_final1, zi_murky, zi_sanitarium, and zi_woods[list]
[*]Fixed player models being invisible in dx8
[*]Fixed tiling HUD icon for Heal ability
[*]Fixed bad number display in the "Auto-spawn" text in the spawn picker
[*]Updated Zombie Engineer's Beacon[list]
[*]Instead of instantly breaking, beacons inside of tight spaces will now place themselves in the closest valid location
[*]Fixed thrown toolboxes appearing offcenter
[*]Thrown toolboxes now break upon touching all clip brushes if they can't find a nearby valid location[/list]
[*]Zombie Sniper Spit cooldown changed from 9 seconds to 6 seconds
[*]Updated Zombie Pyro[list]
[*]Increased Zombie Pyro's melee damage from 45 to 65
[*]Sticky Spew now applies a 20% movement slow 
[*]Standing on puddles of sticky spew applies an additional 20% movement slow
[*]Sticky spew puddles are now larger
[*]Spewed Demoman shield movement slow changed from -60% to -70%
[*]Humans covered in sticky spew are now tinted purple instead of black
[*]Zombie Pyro's death explosion now deals 50 damage, applies afterburn, and turns themself and victims to ash[/list]
[*]Fixed Zombie Heavy exploding into rock gibs when not holding a rock
[*]Fixed the Homewrecker not being able to destroy EMP grenades
[*]Updated Zombie Demoman charge kill icon
[*]Changed Zombie melee impact sounds into fists instead of the sloppy wet Unarmed Combat
[*]Fixed Zombie Spy dealing more damage than intended
[*]Fixed queue events with some zombie abilities
[*]Fixed Zombies sometimes moving slowly after casting an ability[/list]
[/list]
